{{Quote|Qui-Ko is one of the few seers of Tython whose writings on the nature of Ashla have survived to the present.|''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
'''Qui-Ko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Je'daii seer|seer]] serving the [[Je'daii Order]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] before the [[Force Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Qui-Ko was trained in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]<ref name="TJP" />  by the [[Je'daii Order]] on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], one of nine planets in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] which made up the [[Settled Worlds]].<ref name="DOTJ0" /> Qui-Ko wrote many texts based on his study of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Ashla]] and his own [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] of the future. Following the [[Force Wars]], Qui-Ko's teachings and manuscripts were preserved by members of the fledgling [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually making their way into the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Safely housed in the Temple, these text were analyzed by generations of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] reflecting on the origins of the Order, and the earliest teachings of the Force.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Qui-Ko was first mentioned in [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], a [[2010]] reference book by [[Daniel Wallace]]. In the endnotes for ''The Jedi Path'' published at his blog, Wallace suggested that [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] could have been named after Qui-Ko.<ref name="Blog">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/12/endnotes-for-star-wars-jedi-path-part-1.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Jedi Path (part 1 of 4)}}</ref>
